Compose z-order is `Modifier.zIndex`, which belongs to each component's own modifier chain — the codegen has no shared chain (28 components build their own, and only 15 even share build_alignment), so wiring it partially would make the attribute work on some components and silently not on others. z-order also only means anything inside a Box: Column/Row children do not overlap. The iOS implementation degrades to zIndex(-1) for the view-ID form, so there is no richer behaviour to port.
